summary: Iteration 19 — Verified all 5 UI additions + return_url backend flow. (1) Admin login works. (2) Channels page delete flow: 15 channel-delete-btn-* buttons present; clicking opens AlertDialog with '确认删除' enabled when no pending orders; direct DELETE /api/channels/{id} returns {ok:true} HTTP 200. (3) Export Jobs page: summary-expiring='0' tile present, '有效期' column renders 47 job-expiry-<id> badges ('7天后到期'); amber-highlight code path confirmed via source review (no current job within 24h to visually assert). (4) Bell -> Telegram popover: tg-export-expiry-notify checkbox toggles and saves (toast 'Telegram 推送设置已保存'). (5) Checkout settings -> 能量租赁 tab: adding 2 rules yields 2 energy-rule-drag-<i> handles + 2 energy-rule-row-<i> rows; drag-and-drop reorders rows (verified RULE_0,RULE_2 -> RULE_2,RULE_0). (6) Payment success page /pay/SF2026101111505808238: data-testid checkout-success, success-return-merchant, success-tx-hash, success-paid-time all rendered with correct values; language switcher (zh-CN/zh-TW/en) translates labels (verified EN='Return to Merchant', zh-TW='返回商戶'). (7) return_url backend: POST /api/orders (admin) with return_url 'https://merchant.example.com/thanks' stored; GET /api/orders/{order_no}/public returns return_url + paid_at + tx_id for already-paid order SF2026101111505808238.

minor.issue: Invalid return_url schemes (e.g. javascript:, ftp:) are silently stripped to null rather than returning HTTP 422. Safe (no XSS surface), but inconsistent with Pydantic validation elsewhere; consider raising 400 with explicit message.

action_items: (Optional, non-blocking) Decide whether to 422 on invalid return_url schemes in build_order instead of silent-strip.

(Housekeeping) MongoDB has 14 leftover TEST_Channel / TEST_it16_channel docs from previous iterations polluting /channels; main agent may want to add a cleanup script or rely on single-channel seed reset.
critical_code_review_comments: ExportJobsPage.jsx expiryInfo + amber styling path is correct; summary 'summary-expiring' uses expiringSoon count — good.
AlertBell.jsx tg-export-expiry-notify binds to s.export_expiry_notify ?? true (defaults true) — intentional; verified it persists after save.

CheckoutSettingsDialog.jsx uses @dnd-kit SortableContext; drag works via pointer events in Playwright with manual mouse.down/up — reorder persists in local state (not tested for post-save persistence, but save button present and functional based on prior iteration tests).
services.build_order silently drops bad return_url: logically safe but hides caller mistakes.
DB pollution: many TEST_* channels remain; previous iteration 18 claim of 'exactly one channel' no longer holds in current state.
